parsed_json.sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, s.canonical_smiles FROM activities act JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON a.tid = t.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary m ON act.molregno = m.molregno JOIN compound_structures s ON s.molregno = m.molregno WHERE a.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND t.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL203' ORDER BY m.chembl_id, s.canonical_smiles
